title: Languages of Truth: Essays: 2003-2020

vibeProfile.oneLine: Rushdie's essays on storytelling, imagination and the writers he loves.

summary: Nearly two decades of Salman Rushdie's non-fiction, gathered in a rich collection on storytelling, imagination, the writers he loves, and the enduring power of fiction in an age suspicious of it. Ranging from ancient wonder-tales to modern literature and his own creative life, these essays and lectures are erudite, generous and full of delight in books. A warm, expansive companion for readers, and a defence of the truth-telling that only stories can do.
whyReadIt: Two decades of Rushdie on storytelling and the writers he loves. Erudite, generous and full of delight in books.

funFacts.text: The collection gathers essays and lectures spanning from 2003 to 2020.
